record Inner(paths: path[], n: number)
record Outer(inner: Inner, tag: number)
module Pick(items: path[], n: number) {
 const I: Inner = Inner(paths: @items, n: @n)
 const R: Outer = Outer(inner: @I, tag: @n + 100)
 const Whole: Outer = @R
 export const out: path = @Whole.inner.paths[1]
 export const count: number = @Whole.inner.paths.length
 export const tag: number = @Whole.inner.n + @Whole.tag
}
const P: path = segment(start: (0, 0), end: (3, 4))
const Q: path = segment(start: (0, 0), end: (5, 12))
const Values: path[] = [@P, @Q]
const Reverse: path[] = [@Q, @P, @Q]
instance One = Pick(items: @Values, n: 17)
instance Two = Pick(items: @Reverse, n: 41)
const First: path = @One::out
const Second: path = @Two::out
const L: number = @First.length
const M: number = @Second.length
const X: number = @First.endPoint.x
const Y: number = @Second.endPoint.y
const N: number = @One::count
const O: number = @Two::count
const T: number = @One::tag
const U: number = @Two::tag

record Seed(n: number, dx: number, dy: number)
record Shape(p: path, n: number)
module Make(n: number, dx: number, dy: number) {
 const A: Seed = Seed(n: @n, dx: @dx, dy: @dy)
 const Values: Seed[] = [@A]
 const Mapped: Shape[] = for item in @Values { Shape(p: segment(start: (@item.n, 0), end: (@item.n + @item.dx, @item.dy)), n: @item.n + 2) }

 export const out: path = @Chosen.p
 export const tag: number = @Chosen.n

module Make(n: number, dx: number, dy: number, mode: choice(good, bad)) {

 export const tag: number = @Chosen.n
 export const size: number = @Selected.length
}
